anomalies.title: One-Way Mode Multi-Entry Blending Violates Logical Position Isolation
anomalies.description: Bybit perpetual connector operates in One-Way Mode (positionIdx=0). When the strategy receives a second entry signal in the same symbol and side while a previous trade (or remainder) is open, Bybit aggregates them into a single exchange position with a weighted blended entry price. However, the bot's internal state tracks them as separate dictionary entries, creating an impedance mismatch between exchange risk and bot logic.
anomalies.impact: Stop orders from prior trades are either cancelled or rotated with partial quantities, leading to apparent quantity discrepancies (e.g., 6870 entry closed as 8450; 593 entry closed as 822). Hedge Mode does NOT solve this because Hedge Mode only isolates Buy from Sell, not multiple Buys or multiple Sells.
anomalies.remediation: Implement a strict Concurrency Mutex blocking new entries on the same symbol and side until previous position is fully flat, or route concurrent trades to separate Bybit subaccounts.

anomalies.title: Stop Order of Secondary Entry Swallows Remainder of Prior Trade (Case #7)
anomalies.description: In Trade #7 (T-12), parent 896351516234 entered short 6870 CHIP while parent 18400454197 had 1580 CHIP remaining open. After TP1 closed 3430 CHIP, the stop order H-S-896351516234-BB triggered with closeOnTrigger=True and executed for 5020 CHIP (closing the entire exchange position). This swallowed the 1580 CHIP of parent 18400454197, forcing the bot into an emergency [WS POS CLOSED] size=0 synthetic cleanup (SYNTH_FLAT_18400454197).
anomalies.impact: Position isolation is completely broken; prior trade's stop is invalidated and closed without execution of its own stop order.
anomalies.remediation: Do not allow multi-entry on the same side without subaccount isolation.

anomalies.title: Stop Loss Cancel-Replace Naked Interval
anomalies.description: When rotating or resizing stop orders, the bot sends a cancel/deactivate request followed by a new stop order placement. During this network round-trip window (approx 150ms-400ms), the exchange position has no active stop loss registered.
anomalies.impact: If a violent market flash-crash occurs during this sub-second interval, liquidation or runaway loss could occur.
anomalies.remediation: Use Bybit /v5/order/amend endpoint or conditional order edit API rather than cancel-and-replace.

anomalies.title: Funding Settlements Present in Execution Stream
anomalies.description: Bybit /v5/execution/list returns records where execType=='Funding' alongside execType=='Trade'. If not explicitly filtered, trade reconcilers mistake periodic 8-hour funding cash deductions for zero-quantity order fills.
anomalies.impact: Account reconciliation scripts report corrupted fee/pnl statistics if funding records are treated as trades.
anomalies.remediation: Filter all Bybit execution streams strictly where execType == 'Trade'.
